stem: Which of the narrator's statements in scene 1 foreshadows the events that occur in scene 3?

options.label: A
options.text: NARRATOR: . . . I promise you heroes and villains and exciting plot twists (line 1)

options.label: B
options.text: NARRATOR: . . . Her name is Marta. Is she the play's hero, or the villain? (line 3)

options.label: C
options.text: NARRATOR: . . . Marta and Tracy don't really know each other well (line 12)

options.label: D
options.text: NARRATOR: . . . And that brings us to the end of scene one. (line 21)
